q1_issues.issue: The event class absorbs the governing preposition into the verb symbol (crack_down_on) where the instruction set's phrasal-verb form is verb + particle only (crack_down), so this class will not unify with the same verb recorded elsewhere.

The object of "on" is given the direct-object role Patient instead of the preposition-named oblique (On <event> sk_protest_1) that the instruction set prescribes for a PP naming what the activity is directed at ("depend **on** the pump", "work **on** the mural").

q2_gaps: verb + particle + preposition units ("crack down on", "put up with", "come up to"): the instruction set defines verb_particle fusion and preposition-named obliques separately but never says how to split a three-part multi-word verb, so the target NP can land either inside the verb symbol's argument as a role or on an (On …) oblique
notes: The moroccan_police fusion (nationality adjective), its genus, and the predicable modifier genus follow the compound rule, and the definite plural "the protests" correctly becomes a group witness; the collective "police" taking Member rather than GroupOf is also licensed.
